findings.title: Ingress
findings.detail: Workload routes user HTTPS traffic through Azure Front Door so App Service origins never terminate raw HTTP from the Internet.

findings.title: Secret storage
findings.detail: Configuration references Key Vault for database connection material—no plaintext secret strings checked into source.

findings.title: Service map
findings.detail: Application Insights maps HTTP requests into dependency nodes so regressions surface as failing outbound calls rather than silent drop-offs.

findings.title: Scale headroom
findings.detail: Autoscale schedules exist but should be correlated with Front Door POP latency before widening max instances.
